deployment_gate: An AKD service must not be promoted to canonical production state if authorship classification is ORPHANED_AKD_SERVICE.
replication_rule: Replicas inherit authorship but must preserve the canonical authorship_root and predecessor lineage.
rebrand_rule: Rebranding does not sever authorship lineage.
external_provider_rule: External infrastructure may host an AKD-authored service without becoming the author; provider identity is recorded separately from author_id.
